g.title: KayaRank2Convo2 begins.
g.text: KayaRank2Convo2 begins.

g.title: j829606378
g.text: Hi. Could you confirm something for me?

g.title: j1564366476
g.text: The key to your abilities of time travelling is a mix of Technocyte and Void, in some ratio?

g.title: j863114474
g.text: A mix? Are we baking a cake?

g.title: j3537858761
g.text: So your studies are going well, then?

g.title: j2758383488
g.text: Never tried doing that but bet I'd make a great one.

g.title: j161933491
g.text: Super well. I'm super close actually. Super close.

g.title: j48071992
g.text: How do you know that?

g.title: j43272071
g.text: Humble, Nova.

g.title: j2641870625
g.text: How can you be sure?

g.title: j1360225196
g.text: You must have been a great student.

g.title: j1983652040
g.text: I don't have to be humble. I had the highest grade in my high-schools history AND my first year of university had me with the best academic record in 100 years.

g.title: j1956239872
g.text: Have you heard of 'Nora Night'?

g.title: j1976575689
g.text: I had the highest grade in my high-schools history AND my first year of university had me with the best academic record in 100 years.

g.title: j2611358677
g.text: Still doesn't mean you could bake a cake though. Unless you took baking?

g.title: j948647960
g.text: Not smart enough to not take Entrati's serum though, eh?

g.title: j111289441
g.text: I think so, but she's definitely heard of me.

g.title: j2556242252
g.text: Wow, yeah. She's from my time

g.title: j1902990508
g.text: I was beyond a great student. I had universities soliciting me to go there. My first year would have been perfect...

g.title: j1079893251
g.text: Boolean KayaCake is now true.

g.title: j3990369626
g.text: LOL? Look who's talking? If it isn't "Entrati's Teachers Pet". Yeah I heard what everyone said about you

g.title: j3954099741
g.text: Mhmm sure. Well I was able to create a formula for temporal interception that ended up receiving sound waves!

g.title: j1964589068
g.text: If not for... All this?

g.title: j4197690655
g.text: If not for... Entrati?

g.title: j2095405576
g.text: Oh. My. God. You seriously think I couldn't bake a cake?

g.title: j1550199504
g.text: You're making things up to lash out. Why?

g.title: j1893597300
g.text: Are you trying to hurt my feelings?

g.title: j847147761
g.text: So I've been tuning in here and there. I think we'd get along.

g.title: j127835596
g.text: If not for this stupid idiotic internet.

g.title: j1452372797
g.text: A welcomed distraction. Sit tight.

g.title: j2000406657
g.text: Being popular isn't everything you know. What if everyone wants to see you fail? If you're at the top, everyone is going to want to bring you down one day.

g.title: j839492593
g.text: So firstly I can collate my theories and maybe try and intercept a form of matter, lifeless for safety.

g.title: j328701452
g.text: The internet dies eventually, don't worry.

g.title: j2794801372
g.text: So you had a bad time in University because of... the internet.

g.title: j2906669224
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3932882269
g.text: This isn't high school.

g.title: j718720294
g.text: We aren't like that here Nova, we have real shit to deal with.

g.title: j1803818630
g.text: In a way you've left a Wormhole of your own for me to work with, so I guess you're my study partner. Partial credit.

g.title: j1375083167
g.text: Maybe it's me who kills it!

g.title: j2948265938
g.text: I literally just said that.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.

g.title: j2906669224->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
j665394347
g.text: Trusting people gets you hurt. Trusting people on the internet? It'll ruin your life.

g.title: j821309284
g.text: A+ Grade for us both!

g.title: j1488945092
g.text: Glad I could help.

g.title: j631518297
g.text: Ohhh my god, is it me?

g.title: j2349010209
g.text: I'll catch you up real quick since you have the excuse of not knowing how things work here.

g.title: j3501019901
g.text: But are you sure I just didn't leave my radio on?

g.title: j395594542
g.text: Even if I am only barely following.

g.title: j2668315698
g.text: Sorry to say but I really don't know.

g.title: j3582883856
g.text: Oh yeah, totally. Nova is known for taking down the internet. That's why I'm here, to stop you.

g.title: j1321587299
g.text: But people LIE on the internet. They can pretend to be your friend, and they can spread rumors FAST.

g.title: j3100907703
g.text: 100% Sure.

g.title: j1138394157
g.text: Keep following.

g.title: j3549769336
g.text: Lame. Whatever.

g.title: j2626034163
g.text: HA. As if.

g.title: j2558737093
g.text: And once that happens, forget about having a life. Friends. Whatever.

g.title: j3549769336->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
j3139885285
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2388625082
g.text: And yeah so what, it's not like you'd get it. Just leave me alone.

g.title: j3143035734
g.text: No one can stop me when I put my mind to ANYTHING.

g.title: j2114271277
g.text: As you wish. Alone.

g.title: j2384594538
g.text: It's hard for me to know if I'm going to upset you, I'm sorry for whatever happened to you but...

g.title: j3143035734->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
j1345406051
g.text: K.

g.title: j1071490962
g.text: I just need a bit. K. Bye.

g.title: j1345406051->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
j1071490962->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo3.
